hashing: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with object keys sorted recursively, no insignificant whitespace or final newline; same algorithm as publicResearchHash. These are actual persisted review records, not source-page raw-byte hashes.

leaseHandoffReview.verification: Static review only; new regression and hosted rerun completion remain separate exact-release evidence.

permissionBoundary: The .2 review is not activation or spending authority. Fresh exact .2 template/scope and owner approval are required; old grants, stopped windows and held liabilities remain unchanged. Original source citations and 2026-10-19 validity cutoff are preserved.
schemaMapping: The current sourcePolicy has restrictionsRevision, termsReviewHash and independentReviewHash. sourceReviewHash/recipientReviewHash are evidence-manifest fields; do not invent new production policy fields or substitute them for sourcePolicyHash/ownerApprovalHash.
validityReason: Seven-day initial operational review-freshness choice, not a provider warranty or legal expiry; template/source/knowledge expiry must not exceed it, and changed terms, exclusions, recipients, schemas or material behavior require earlier review/revocation. Per-run dispatch remains 30 minutes and receipt grace 30 minutes.
